title: limonium dissitiflorum
intro: Limonium dissitiflorum, commonly known as Sea Lavender, is a plant species belonging to the Plumbaginaceae family. It is valued for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, helping to soothe skin irritations and wounds. The therapeutic actions of Sea Lavender include its calming effects on the nervous system, reducing anxiety and promoting relaxation. The bioactive constituents of Limonium dissitiflorum include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
